name: pypi_token_recognizer
note: PyPI / TestPyPI API token: 'pypi-' + base64 macaroon whose first bytes encode pypi.org (AgEIcHlwaS5vcmc) or test.pypi.org (AgENdGVzdC5weXBpLm9yZw), 70+ more characters. Source: detect-secrets (Apache-2.0) detect_secrets/plugins/pypi_token.py; leading \b added and the [A-Za-z0-9-_] class (range 9-_) corrected.
